<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum shows a single signal at 167.15 ppm, which lies in the typical carbonyl region for esters (160‑170 ppm). No other peaks appear in the carbonyl range (≈180‑210 ppm). Therefore the molecule contains one carbonyl carbon, i.e., one carbonyl group.</thought>
